headline: Referee body admits 'error of judgment' over Haaland goal in Manchester derby
summary: Pro Ref acknowledged that the winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 victory over Manchester United was wrongly allowed to stand.
details: Professional Game Referees (Pro Ref) admitted on Sunday that the decision to allow Erling Haaland's winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 victory over Manchester United was an "error of judgment".

The goal was initially disallowed for offside, but VAR overturned the decision. Although City midfielder Enzo Fernandez was in an offside position and attempted to reach the ball, the goal was given because he did not touch it.
Pro Ref later stated that the VAR did not recognize the likely impact of Fernandez's position and should have recommended an on-field review.
Manchester United manager Michael Carrick described the decision as "worrying", while defender Lisandro Martinez called the goal an "injustice", claiming he was impacted by Fernandez's presence.
The refereeing body has contacted Manchester United to acknowledge the mistake and confirmed that a review of the incident will take place.
caption:
A winning goal that shouldn't have stood. Pro Ref admits a major VAR error in the Manchester derby.

Professional Game Referees (Pro Ref) admitted on Sunday that the decision to allow Erling Haaland's winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 victory over Manchester United was an "error of judgment".

The goal was initially disallowed for offside, but VAR overturned the decision. Although City midfielder Enzo Fernandez was in an offside position and attempted to reach the ball, the goal was given because he did not touch it.

Pro Ref later stated that the VAR did not recognize the likely impact of Fernandez's position and should have recommended an on-field review.

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick described the decision as "worrying", while defender Lisandro Martinez called the goal an "injustice", claiming he was impacted by Fernandez's presence.

The refereeing body has contacted Manchester United to acknowledge the mistake and confirmed that a review of the incident will take place.

headline_marked: India beat Sri Lanka by 72 runs to [[win eighth Women's Asia Cup title]]
headline: India beat Sri Lanka by 72 runs to win eighth Women's Asia Cup title
summary: A record-breaking opening partnership and a dominant spin attack led India to victory at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium.
details: India secured their eighth Women's Asia Cup title, and fourth in the T20 format, by defeating Sri Lanka by 72 runs on Sunday.
The victory was built on a record-breaking opening stand of 129 runs by Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana, the highest partnership for any wicket in Women's T20 Asia Cup history.
Shafali Verma smashed 68 off 39 balls, while Smriti Mandhana contributed 59 off 39 balls, helping India post a formidable total of 183-5.
In response, Sri Lanka struggled to keep up with the run rate and were eventually bundled out for 111, despite Chamari Athapaththu scoring 36.
India's spin attack proved decisive, with Shree Charani taking 4-20 and Deepti Sharma claiming 3-19 to dismantle the Sri Lankan batting lineup.
With this win, India now holds a 6-1 lead over Sri Lanka in their encounters in Asia Cup finals.
caption:
A record-breaking opening stand and a spin-bowling masterclass! India are the Women's Asia Cup champions once again.

India secured their eighth Women's Asia Cup title, and fourth in the T20 format, by defeating Sri Lanka by 72 runs on Sunday.

The victory was built on a record-breaking opening stand of 129 runs by Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana, the highest partnership for any wicket in Women's T20 Asia Cup history.

Shafali Verma smashed 68 off 39 balls, while Smriti Mandhana contributed 59 off 39 balls, helping India post a formidable total of 183-5.

In response, Sri Lanka struggled to keep up with the run rate and were eventually bundled out for 111, despite Chamari Athapaththu scoring 36.

India's spin attack proved decisive, with Shree Charani taking 4-20 and Deepti Sharma claiming 3-19 to dismantle the Sri Lankan batting lineup.

With this win, India now holds a 6-1 lead over Sri Lanka in their encounters in Asia Cup finals.
